inputs.prompt: Epic continuous cinematic battle montage, ancient Chinese northern frontier war. The same young Chinese female general in dark heavy armor and a war helm with long black hair charges on her black war horse into the battlefield, swinging her long curved saber at enemy cavalry; two armored soldiers clash blades up close with sparks flying; a shield is slammed by a spear; a war horse gallops past right in front of the camera; soldiers run along the top of the city wall; arrows streak across the sky; flames, smoke, swirling yellow sand and torn battle flags fill the whole battlefield. Fast dynamic camera with speed and pressure. Then the battle sound drops into a brief lull: the female general stands alone on horseback amid blowing yellow sand, behind her burning beacon towers and a broken ruined wall. She slowly raises her long saber, the wind moves her banner, the camera slowly pushes in from behind her then settles into a front close-up of her cold resolute face. Suddenly war drums return. She spurs her black horse and charges forward leading hundreds of cavalry in a mass charge, hundreds of war horses thundering across the ground churning yellow sand, a low-angle shot of hooves racing past the camera then the camera quickly soars up to a vast high aerial view of the grand ancient battlefield, ending frozen on the moment she swings her saber charging into battle. Real ancient Chinese armor and cold weapons, real skin and real war horses, volumetric light, dust, firelight, warm-cool contrast, film color grade, IMAX epic war cinema, continuous with the previous shot, 16:9. No audio - silent video.
